summary: `:server` authentication per §4–§6.6: verify Google OIDC ID token, issue HS256 JWT (15 min) + rotating refresh token (30 d), `mux_refresh` cookie for web (with local HTTP dev handling), bootstrap admin, `GET/PATCH /me` (with self-visible `emergencyContact`/`isMinor`/`notes`/`guardians`), session management, and `consent_required` guard. **Server only**.
overview:
Third platform slice after **infra**, **schema v0.2**, and **`:core` contract**. Wires Ktor `Authentication` + routes under `/api/v1/auth/*` and `/api/v1/me*` using SQLite v0.2 tables (`platform-schema-v02`) and `:core` DTOs (`platform-core-contract`).

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §4.1–4.5, §5.4, §6.6–6.7, §6.10 · `docs/decisiones.md` (Google OIDC, no Firebase).

**Prerequisites**
- `platform-server-infra`: `EnvConfig`, `DatabaseAccess`, Koin, CORS+credentials, `TrustedProxy`, `RequestUserIdKey`, `ErrorHandling`.
- `platform-schema-v02`: `google_identities`, `sessions`, `refresh_tokens`, `user_accounts`, `users`, `user_guardians`.
- `platform-core-contract`: auth + `UserSelf`/`UserPatchMe`/`MeResponse` DTOs, `PatchField`, `permissionsForRole`.

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `./gradlew :server:test` green including full auth integration tests with a local test RSA JWKS server (`GOOGLE_JWKS_URL`).
- `POST /api/v1/auth/google` (native) → `200` + `accessToken` + `refreshToken`; `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` rotates refresh token; reusing a previously used refresh token → `401` and revokes the entire session.
- `POST /api/v1/auth/google` (web) sets `Set-Cookie: mux_refresh` (`HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/api/v1/auth`; `Secure` enabled when `PUBLIC_BASE_URL` starts with `https://`, omitted on local `http://`; `Domain` set only when `COOKIE_DOMAIN` is non-blank).
- `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` accepts either Bearer or `mux_refresh` cookie (idempotent) so an expired JWT still revokes the session and clears the cookie.
- `GET /api/v1/me` returns `UserSelf` (including `emergencyContact`, `isMinor`, `notes`, and `guardians` when minor) + `permissions` list.
- `PATCH /api/v1/me` requires `version` (`409 version_conflict` on mismatch), ignores unknown fields (§6.4), rejects known non-editable `User` fields with `403 field_not_editable`, and persists allowed §5.4 fields.
- When `consent.dataProcessing == false`, any non-allowlisted authenticated route returns `403 consent_required`; allowlist includes `/me`, `PATCH /me`, `/me/export`, `/me/sessions*`, `/auth/logout`, `/auth/logout-all`.
- `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL` creates one `invited` admin user on empty DB (idempotent).
- No Google ID token, `googleSub`, or raw refresh token ever appears in responses (except native `refreshToken`) or logs.
shared_ui_policy: No UI in this slice. Web GIS integration lives in `platform-web-shell`.
out_of_scope:
- Compose / GIS / wasm webapp (`platform-web-shell`).
- `GET /me/export` and consent setup UI (`platform-me-rgpd`).
- `PUT/DELETE /me/avatar` (`platform-files`).
- User and account administration routes (`spec-05-members`).
- Rate limiting for `/public/*`, general private routes, and uploads (`platform-rate-limits` unifies with auth limits).
- Firebase or personal API tokens (§4.7).

external_systems.name: Google OAuth JWKS
external_systems.role: Fetch RS256 public keys from `GOOGLE_JWKS_URL` (cached per `Cache-Control`); verify `iss`, `aud`, `exp`, `iat`, `email_verified`, optional `nonce`.

auth.server: Google ID token verify → invite-only account lookup/link → session + HS256 JWT (`iss`, `sub`, `role`, `sid`). Refresh cookie (`web`) or JSON body (`native`). Bearer + active session/account check (cache ≤ 30 s, immediate local invalidation) on protected routes.

components.name: Application.module
components.usage: Install `Authentication` (JWT Bearer), `ConsentRequiredPlugin`, register `authRoutes()` and `meRoutes()` under `/api/v1`, run `BootstrapAdmin`, and launch 24 h session purge coroutine.

components.name: GoogleIdTokenService
components.usage: Interface + JWKS RS256 verifier checking signature, `iss`, `aud ∈ GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS`, `exp`/`iat` (60 s leeway), `email_verified=true`, and optional `nonce`.
components.notes: Test suite uses real RSA keys served from a local test JWKS endpoint via `GOOGLE_JWKS_URL` (§10.1.1).

components.name: JwtService
components.usage: Issue HS256 access tokens (15 min; `iss`, `sub=userId`, `role`, `sid`, `iat`, `exp`) and verify with 30 s leeway + `JWT_SECRET_PREVIOUS` rotation fallback.

components.name: SessionService
components.usage: Create sessions + 32-byte base64url refresh tokens (store SHA-256 hash only); atomic rotation with reuse detection (revokes whole session); verify account `active` on refresh; TTL ≤ 30 s status cache with immediate local invalidation on logout/revoke/disable; 24 h purge of expired/old revoked sessions.

components.name: AccountLinkingService
components.usage: §4.1 invite-only lookup in one transaction: find by `google_sub`, else by lowercase `login_email` with `status = invited` and no `google_identities` row → link `google_sub` + set `active`; else `403 not_invited` / `403 account_disabled`; update `last_login_at`.
components.notes: Never mutates `login_email` if the user's Google email changed.

components.name: BootstrapAdmin
components.usage: On startup after Flyway: if zero `admin` rows exist in `user_accounts` and `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL` is set, insert minimal `User` (`name` = email local-part or «Administració») + `invited` `admin` account.

components.name: UserSelfMapper
components.usage: Map DB user + account + guardians + derived `isMinor` + `orgRoles` → `:core` `UserSelf` and `MeResponse`.

components.name: ConsentRequiredPlugin
components.usage: Route-scoped plugin blocking authenticated calls with `403 consent_required` while `consent.dataProcessing == false`, except the explicit allowlist.
components.notes: Also provide role-checking helper `requireRole(...)` for feature slices.

components.name: AuthRoutes & MeRoutes
components.usage: Implement §6.6 auth endpoints (with Origin CSRF check and auth rate limits) + `/me` and `/me/sessions` endpoints.

components.name: Auth.sq
components.usage: SQLDelight queries for `user_accounts`, `google_identities`, `sessions`, `refresh_tokens`, `users` self read/update (with optimistic `version` check), and `user_guardians`.

structure:
Authentication request lifecycle:

```text
POST /api/v1/auth/google
  → Origin CSRF check (if Origin present, must be ∈ CORS_ORIGINS)
  → Auth rate limit (20 / 15 min per resolved client IP)
  → GoogleIdTokenService.verify(idToken, nonce)
  → AccountLinkingService.linkOrResolve(sub, email) [write tx]
  → SessionService.createSession(userId, clientType, userAgent) [write tx]
  → JwtService.issue(userId, role, sid)
  → Response: AuthTokenResponse + Set-Cookie mux_refresh (web) | refreshToken (native)

Protected request (Authorization: Bearer <jwt>)
  → JwtService.verify → AuthPrincipal(userId, role, sid)
  → SessionService.assertActive(sid, userId) [≤30s cache + immediate local invalidation]
  → call.attributes.put(RequestUserIdKey, userId)
  → ConsentRequiredPlugin (unless route is allowlisted)
  → Route handler
```

sections.title: Cookie policy (production vs local development)
sections.behavior: Set `Secure` when `PUBLIC_BASE_URL` starts with `https://`; omit `Secure` on local `http://` dev so browsers store the cookie. Set `Domain=<COOKIE_DOMAIN>` only when `COOKIE_DOMAIN` is configured (omit in local dev → host-only cookie on `localhost`). On logout, expire cookie with matching attributes (`Max-Age=0`).

sections.title: PATCH /me field classification (§5.4 & §6.4)
sections.description: Editable self fields: `nickname`, `phoneNumber`, `aboutMe`, `address`, `emergencyContact`, `sizes`, `consent.dataProcessing` (monotonic `false -> true`), `consent.publicProfile`, `consent.imageRights`, `consent.whatsapp`, `consent.signedAt`, `consent.signedBy`, plus required `version`.
sections.behavior: Inspect incoming raw `JsonObject` before decoding `UserPatchMe`: unknown JSON keys are **ignored** (§6.4); known non-editable `User` keys (`name`, `lastNames`, `birthDate`, `documentId`, `email`, `status`, `membershipType`, `memberNumber`, `joinedAt`, `leftAt`, `heightCm`, `guardians`, `account`, `notes`, `groupId`) return `403 field_not_editable`. Version mismatch returns `409 version_conflict` with `error.current`.

sections.title: consent_required allowlist (`decisiones.md`)
sections.description: While `consent.dataProcessing == false`, the user can access only: `GET /api/v1/me`, `PATCH /api/v1/me`, `GET /api/v1/me/export`, `GET /api/v1/me/sessions`, `DELETE /api/v1/me/sessions/{id}`, `POST /api/v1/auth/logout`, `POST /api/v1/auth/logout-all`.
sections.behavior: Every other authenticated `/api/v1/*` route returns `403 consent_required`. Tests verify this by registering a test-only probe route inside `testApplication` (never shipped in production routing).

sections.title: Logout without active Bearer token
sections.description: `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` (§6.6) is callable even if the 15-minute access token has already expired.
sections.behavior: Verify `Origin` header if present. If a valid Bearer token is present, revoke its `sid`; else if `mux_refresh` cookie (or body `refreshToken`) matches a session, revoke that session; always clear `mux_refresh` cookie and respond `204`.

endpoints.name: Auth config
endpoints.notes: Public. Returns first entry of `GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS` as `googleClientId`.

endpoints.name: Google login
endpoints.notes: `GoogleAuthRequest` → `AuthTokenResponse`. Origin check + rate limit 20 / 15 min per IP.

endpoints.name: Refresh session
endpoints.notes: Cookie (`web`) or body `refreshToken` (`native`). Rotates token; reuse revokes session; checks account `active`. Origin check + rate limit 60 / min per IP.

endpoints.name: Logout current session
endpoints.notes: Accepts Bearer or `mux_refresh` cookie (idempotent `204`); clears cookie; Origin check.

endpoints.name: Logout all sessions
endpoints.notes: Revokes all sessions for current user, invalidates local cache, clears cookie (`204`).

endpoints.name: Update own profile
endpoints.notes: RFC 7386 Merge Patch with required `version`. Only §5.4 editable self fields.

endpoints.name: Revoke own session
endpoints.notes: Revokes session owned by current user (`404` if not owned); immediate cache invalidation.

persistence: SQLite v0.2 via SQLDelight (`Auth.sq`) and `DatabaseAccess.writeTransaction`. Refresh tokens are 32 cryptographically random bytes encoded base64url; only SHA-256 hex/base64 hash is persisted.

tasks.title: Gradle: Ktor auth-jwt + JWKS dependencies
tasks.spec: Add `ktor-server-auth`, `ktor-server-auth-jwt`, and `com.auth0:jwks-rsa` / `java-jwt` to `gradle/libs.versions.toml` and `server/build.gradle.kts`. No Firebase.

tasks.title: SQLDelight Auth.sq queries
tasks.spec: Add `Auth.sq` queries: lookup account by `google_sub`, lookup invited account by `login_email`, insert `google_identities`, activate account + update `last_login_at`, CRUD `sessions` & `refresh_tokens`, purge expired/old revoked sessions, read user + guardians + orgRoles for `/me`, and optimistic-locked update of self fields.
acceptance_criteria: Generated `TabalaDatabase` compiles and unit test exercises session + refresh hash persistence

tasks.title: GoogleIdTokenService (JWKS RS256)
tasks.spec: Implement JWKS key provider (respecting `Cache-Control`) pointing to `EnvConfig.googleJwksUrl`. Validate RS256 signature, `iss`, `aud`, `exp`/`iat` (60 s margin), `email_verified=true`, and optional `nonce`. Map all failures to `401 invalid_google_token`.
acceptance_criteria: Tests with local RSA JWKS test server reject bad signature, expired token, wrong `aud`, wrong `iss`, `email_verified=false`, and mismatched `nonce`

tasks.title: JwtService + Ktor Authentication plugin
tasks.spec: Issue 15-min HS256 JWT (`iss`, `sub`, `role`, `sid`, `iat`, `exp`) and verify with 30 s leeway plus `JWT_SECRET_PREVIOUS` fallback. Install Ktor `Authentication` attaching `AuthPrincipal` and setting `RequestUserIdKey`.
acceptance_criteria: Expired or tampered JWT returns `401 unauthenticated`
Token signed with `JWT_SECRET_PREVIOUS` still validates during key rotation

tasks.title: SessionService (rotation, reuse revoke, cache, purge)
tasks.spec: Implement session creation, atomic refresh rotation (verify account still `active`, detect reuse of an already-used token and revoke entire session → `401 session_revoked`), sliding 30 d expiry, `userAgent` truncation to 200 chars, in-memory `sid`/`userId` status cache (TTL ≤ 30 s with immediate invalidation API for logout/admin actions), and 24 h purge coroutine.
acceptance_criteria: Double use of same refresh token revokes session and returns `401`
Refresh fails if account status became `disabled`
Purge deletes sessions expired or revoked > 30 days ago

tasks.title: AccountLinkingService + BootstrapAdmin
tasks.spec: Implement §4.1 invite-only lookup/link transaction (`not_invited`, `account_disabled`, first-login `invited -> active`, ignore subsequent Google email changes) and idempotent `BootstrapAdmin` on startup.
acceptance_criteria: Invited email links `googleSub` and becomes `active`; subsequent login matches by `googleSub` even if Google email changes
Non-invited returns `403 not_invited`; disabled returns `403 account_disabled`
`BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL` creates one invited admin on empty DB and is idempotent

tasks.title: AuthRoutes + cookies + CSRF Origin check + auth rate limits
tasks.spec: Implement `GET /auth/config`, `POST /auth/google`, `POST /auth/refresh`, `POST /auth/logout` (Bearer or cookie, idempotent), `POST /auth/logout-all`. Enforce `Origin ∈ CORS_ORIGINS` on auth POSTs when `Origin` is present (`403 forbidden`), cookie attributes for HTTPS vs local HTTP, and in-memory IP rate limits (`20/15min` on `/auth/google`, `60/min` on `/auth/refresh`) using `TrustedProxy.resolvedClientIp()`.
acceptance_criteria: Logout succeeds even after Bearer token expiry using cookie

tasks.title: UserSelfMapper, MeRoutes, and ConsentRequiredPlugin
tasks.spec: Implement `UserSelfMapper` (returning `emergencyContact`, `isMinor`, `notes`, `guardians` if minor, plus `permissions`), `GET/PATCH /me` (ignoring unknown keys, `403 field_not_editable` for known non-editable `User` fields, `409 version_conflict` with `error.current`), `GET/DELETE /me/sessions`, and `ConsentRequiredPlugin` with full allowlist (including `/me/export`).
acceptance_criteria: Unknown JSON property on `PATCH /me` is ignored (200)
Known non-editable field (e.g. `status` or `memberNumber`) on `PATCH /me` returns `403 field_not_editable`
`consent.dataProcessing=false` blocks non-allowlisted test route with `403 consent_required` while allowing `/me` and `/me/export`

tasks.title: Koin wiring + Auth integration test suite (§10.1.3)
tasks.spec: Register auth services in `ServerModules`, launch session purge in `Application.module`, and write end-to-end `testApplication` tests covering all §10.1.3 scenarios plus log-capture assertion confirming no Google ID token, `googleSub`, or refresh token is logged.
acceptance_criteria: Zero secrets/tokens in captured log output
